observations: Added high-side windows and more complete vertical walls; ceiling field is clearer than the previous hanging installation.
A broad low-looking horizontal ceiling still dominates; a foreground column increases perspective depth. One image cannot verify physical ceiling height or lens parameters.
The former direct narrow passage beside the reception counter with continuous door rhythm is no longer prominent.
A wider background opening and discreet doors are visible, but the oversized central sculpture obscures the transition and onward privacy sequence.
Reception service, a seating group with tables, and the art focal point are readable.
Waiting and art presence satisfy at least two visible relationships in a preliminary reading; onward circulation remains ambiguous.
Warm white low-contrast background, localized purple, natural light and indirect lighting remain.
The central mass reads as densely stacked feather/petal-like pieces rather than the previous light architectural sheet system; translucency and layered optical depth are weaker.
The purple pillow extends the accent onto soft furnishing, while approved palette scope emphasizes thin-sheet inner layers and small details.
Directional sunlight and defined shadows are stronger than before, so softly diffused light is not equally preserved.

nextRoundIssues: Scale, thickness and feather/petal association of the central installation
Clarity of the open transition and privacy access behind the installation
Whether gallery height is truly achieved instead of mainly ceiling framing and perspective
Local-purple surface scope and soft natural-light fidelity
